sum: Paysign, Inc. provides prepaid card programs, patient affordability offerings, digital banking, life science software technology solutions, and integrated payment processing services for businesses, consumers, and government institutions in the United States. The company offers solutions for corporate rewards, prepaid gift cards, general-purpose reloadable debit cards, employee incentives, consumer rebates, donor compensation, clinical trials, healthcare reimbursement payments and pharmaceutical payment assistance, and demand deposit accounts accessible with a debit card and software solutions. It also operates a customer service center; and offers a communication suite, including mobile app, two-way SMS, text alerts, and cardholder web portal. It markets its prepaid card solutions under the Paysign brand name. The company serves companies and municipalities that require payment solutions for rewards, rebates, payment assistance, and other payments to their customers, employees, agents, and others. Paysign, Inc. was founded in 2001 and is headquartered in Henderson, Nevada.
ceo: Mr. Mark R. Newcomer (Co-Founder, President, CEO & Director)
